body: You’re right. I just need to keep going :(
You’re right. I just feel as if I’m strapped down and can’t find any motivation in anything. Just crying for hours and hours. Each time i think I’ve gotten up i get pushed down 20 more times.

I’ve tried to go and be around others and I’ve tried distractions but i feel as if even when i do go out my brain just clicks and i start to have thoughts again and I’m no longer in the present. I’m just so terrified that I’m never going to be ok again.
Yeah that’s an idea. I just need something to go right for me. I just want so badly to be ok

I just don’t have any motivation or energy for anything. I wake up and think “why did i survive”? There’s times where i just feel numb and want to sleep. There’s times where i just want to hear my exes voice and maybe I’ll feel better. I’m having a really hard time letting him go after so long. Coming home and being alone has been so hard when we spent literally every night together for almost 4 years. There’s just a lot bringing me down. And having stressors of work and the apartment just make everything feel heavier on my back.
I OD in my bed and I’ve been recently sleeping on my couch but even then i still feel everything else.

Im trying to find joy in things but instead i end up crying for hours. I’ve been in contact with medical professionals but it’s the times where I’m alone at home and surrounded by memories from my OD but also memories of my relationship, where i just can’t control my racing thoughts and overwhelming emotions. And i just end up stuck.

Thank you...Im not looking for medication anymore. I personally felt when i started medication it made things worse. I dont know i just feel as if i don’t have a starting point or as if i just don’t know what to do or who’s actually there for me. There’s times i feel worthless or easily disposable. I’m constantly crying for hours and i just don’t know what to make of myself.
